A small cropped subset of the pulmonary fibrosis lung data

Source: R/exampleData.R
lungSubset.Rd

Xenium data of lung biopsies from Vannan et al. (2025), available in full as SpatialDatasets::spe_Vannan_2025(), cut down to ship with the package. It has five control and five pulmonary fibrosis biopsies (the five with the fewest cells of each), each cropped to the roughly 3,000 cells in a square window at its centre, so each image is a window of a larger biopsy. Every image comes from a different subject. Cell types with fewer than 20 cells in the windows are removed. The hierarchy for these cell types is in lungCellTypeTree.

Usage

data(lungSubset)

Format

A SpatialExperiment with the raw counts of 343 genes in 29,971 cells (assay counts), the cell coordinates in spatialCoords(), and in colData:

cellID

A unique cell ID.

imageID

The image (the window of a biopsy); also sample_id.

subject

The patient.

cellType

The cell type label.

disease_status

"Control" or "Disease".

Source

Built from SpatialDatasets::spe_Vannan_2025() by data-raw/lungSubset.R.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
lungSubset
#> class: SpatialExperiment 
#> dim: 343 29971 
#> metadata(0):
#> assays(1): counts
#> rownames(343): ABCC2 ACKR1 ... YAP1 ZEB1
#> rowData names(0):
#> colnames(29971): TILD167LA_aiflfbgd-1 TILD167LA_aifmhkpg-1 ...
#>   VUILD105MA2_aaaafoki-1 VUILD105MA2_aaaafokj-1
#> colData names(6): cellID imageID ... disease_status sample_id
#> reducedDimNames(0):
#> mainExpName: NULL
#> altExpNames(0):
#> spatialCoords names(2) : x y
#> imgData names(0):
table(lungSubset$imageID, lungSubset$disease_status)
#>              
#>               Control Disease
#>   TILD049MA         0    2989
#>   TILD113LA         0    2997
#>   TILD167LA         0    2999
#>   VUHD038        2997       0
#>   VUHD069        2999       0
#>   VUHD090        2997       0
#>   VUHD095        3000       0
#>   VUHD113        3000       0
#>   VUILD105MA2       0    2996
#>   VUILD142MA        0    2997
